Generative agent-based modeling with actions grounded in physical, social, or digital space using Concordia

PreprintarXiv2023-12-06accessed 2026-10-24
this record asyaml sourcemarkdownjson

locator

notes

Agents state intended actions in natural language; a Game Master agent, inspired by tabletop RPGs, decides outcomes, checks physical plausibility, and can call digital tools. Behavior comes from components mediating LLM calls and associative memory retrieval.
